service.ur: نیا ایمریٹس آئی ڈی جاری کرنا

about: Get an Emirates ID card for the first time.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Open to UAE citizens, residents and GCC citizens
The applicant, a family head, a legal representative or a guardian can apply
Passport valid for at least 3 months for categories that need it
Anyone aged 15 or over gives fingerprints and a signature at a service centre
documents: A personal photo that meets ICAO standards
Passport where the category needs it
Proof for the category, such as a GCC ID, student, job, business licence, property or kinship papers
fees: Citizens: 100 AED for a 5-year card under 21, 200 AED for a 10-year card at 21 or over
Residents: 100 AED per year of residence
Urgent service 150 AED, at service centres only
timing: Card is 5 years under 21 and 10 years over 21 for citizens
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
